scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,api,auth -c auto "pnpm --filter @meetra/web dev" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:auth"
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && conda run -n meetra-api --no-capture-output celery -A app.worker.celery_app worker --loglevel=info
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && conda run -n meetra-api --no-capture-output python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
scripts.dev:auth: cd apps/auth-service && conda run -n meetra-api --no-capture-output python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${AUTH_PORT:-8001}
scripts.auth:db:upgrade: cd apps/auth-service && conda run -n meetra-api alembic upgrade head
scripts.auth:db:downgrade: cd apps/auth-service && conda run -n meetra-api alembic downgrade -1
scripts.auth:db:current: cd apps/auth-service && conda run -n meetra-api alembic current
scripts.auth:db:history: cd apps/auth-service && conda run -n meetra-api alembic history
